thread:
sara: Quick note from pairing with onboarding last week  the quickstart has three examples: RW_API_KEY, REDWOOD_KEY, and REDWOOD_API_TOKEN. New hires keep pasting the wrong env and then hitting 401s when running the sample app. Can we pick one canonical name + a short migration path?

jon: Yea, this keeps tripping people up. I'd vote for a shorter name: RW_API_KEY. Easier to type and consistent with other RW_* vars.

maya: short names are nice but we should also be explicit about scope. Suggest: RW_API_KEY (required), RW_ORG (optional for dev, required for prod), RW_PROJECT (optional).

paul: parity note: CLI currently reads REDWOOD_KEY, Python SDK reads REDWOOD_API_TOKEN, Node reads RW_API_KEY. We need an ordered lookup and a single deprecation message when falling back. Proposed lookup order: 1) RW_API_KEY 2) REDWOOD_API_TOKEN 3) REDWOOD_KEY. Emit one-time deprecation warning if (2) or (3) used.

sara: sounds good. also propose a tiny helper for quickstarts: `bin/load-dev-creds` that does `export RW_API_KEY=... && export RW_ORG=...` and prints a hint if it detects a token labeled "dev".

maya: rotation handling: SDKs should treat an auth 401 with header `x-rw-rotate=true` as a special case. Recommend a standardized error body: { "error": "auth:rotated", "when": "2026-05-01T14:02:00Z", "hint": "update RW_API_KEY or refresh via CLI" }. SDKs can surface that hint and optionally attempt a short exponential retry if a configured refresh hook is present.

jon: agree on the header + shape. For security we should avoid automated refresh unless an explicit refresh callback is registered. Otherwise just surface a human-friendly message and a link to docs.

rotations-bot: rotated key svc-frontend-prod (id: sa-90122) at 2026-05-01T14:02:07Z :lock:

paul: docs: update quickstart to show how to persist credentials to a profile at `~/.redwood/credentials` with format: `RW_API_KEY=...
RW_ORG=...
RW_PROJECT=...`. SDKs should read profile when env var missing.

maya: one more: deprecation policy = keep fallbacks for exactly two releases, print deprecation warning once per process, and include migration CLI helper `redwood migrate-env` to convert legacy vars to RW_API_KEY in shells.

sara: can someone open a tiny RFC with the env resolution table, the rotate error convention, and a checklist for JS/Python/CLI parity? I'll coordinate with onboarding to change the quickstart snippet.

jon: I'll start the RFC and add a tiny unit test matrix for env resolution. thanks! :rocket:
